name: qwencloud-text
title: QwenCloud Text
description: Generate text, chat, code and reasoning with QwenCloud text models - pick the lane, call the API, handle rate limits.

steps.instruction: Route through the provider chain: free lane first when cost must be zero, paid qwen-plus/qwen-max when quality gates demand.
Keep prompts lean: system role plus the task; compact history once it grows past 24 turns.
For bulk jobs (batch summarise, polish, translate) script the calls with retries and exponential backoff.
When the output drives tools, ask for strict JSON via function calling and validate it before use.
On 429: back off, then fail over to the next lane - never drop the request silently.
Meter every call and stop when the cost guardrail trips.
